notes.title: One Day till the RELEASE!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43424426/b42f0166003b41302a0c05365d796af99e35cbe1.jpg

Hey guys!

The release date is round the corner! 
Tomorrow, May 30, "Shut Up and Dance: Special Edition" will be fully available on Steam! Hopefully you will enjoy the game and will have TONS of fun playing it, meeting new characters, and opening new hot scenes! I'm sure full nine episodes won't let you get bored and future eps. will give you even more fun!

Meanwhile, Megan has prepared something special and can't wait to see you!
